title: Copper
heading: Scrap Copper
lede: Copper pays more per kilo than any other common scrap metal. Bring in your pipe, wire and offcuts, and we'll grade it, weigh it and pay you for every kilo.

seo.title: Scrap Copper
seo.description: Sell scrap copper pipe, wire and offcuts to Metal Werx in Hallam. We grade it, weigh it and pay by bank transfer the same day, for homes, trades and businesses across Melbourne's south-east.

paragraphs.text: Copper is graded on how clean it is. Bare, bright wire is worth the most, clean pipe a little less, and copper with solder, paint, fittings or insulation less again. Sorting it before you come in can lift the price of the whole load.
Plumbers, electricians and air-con installers bring us their offcuts, and so do homeowners clearing out a shed or renovating. A handful of pipe or a ute load, we'll weigh it and pay you for it.

grades.title: Bright & Shiny
grades.text: Bare, uncoated copper wire with no solder, paint or tarnish. The top grade.

grades.title: Clean Pipe
grades.text: Copper pipe and offcuts with the fittings, solder and insulation removed.

grades.title: Mixed Copper
grades.text: Painted, soldered, tinned or tarnished copper, and pipe with a little solder left on.

grades.title: Copper with Attachments
grades.text: Pipe with brass fittings or steel still on. Cut the extras off for a better price.

details.heading: What We Buy
details.intro: If it's copper, we'll take it, from a short offcut to a whole house's worth of pipe. A few minutes of sorting before you come in can lift the price.

items.text: Bare copper wire, busbar and earth strap
Cut off brass fittings and steel brackets
Keep bare wire apart from pipe
Pull off insulation foam, plastic and tape
Keep copper out of mixed loads of steel

faq.intro: Common questions about selling scrap copper.

questions.question: Should I strip insulated copper wire?
questions.answer: Only if it's thick. Stripped copper is worth more than wire with the insulation on, but thin cable takes a long time to strip for very little gain. We buy insulated cable as it is, as PVC wire. Never burn the insulation off: it's illegal, the smoke is toxic, and burnt wire is graded lower.

questions.question: Do you buy copper hot water cylinders?
questions.answer: Yes. Drain them, and take off the outer case if there is one. Fittings left on lower the grade, so cut them off if you can.

questions.question: Why was my copper paid at a lower grade?
questions.answer: Copper is graded on how clean it is. Solder, paint, fittings, insulation and corrosion all move it down a grade. Ask us and we'll show you what held your load back, so you know for next time.

questions.question: Do you buy copper from trades and businesses?
questions.answer: Yes. Plumbers, electricians and air-con installers sell us their offcuts all the time. If your business produces a lot of copper, ask us about a bin on site.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

cta.heading: Got Copper to Sell?
cta.text: Bring it to our Hallam yard, or tell us what you've got and we'll give you a price.

title: Brass
heading: Scrap Brass
lede: Old taps, plumbing fittings, valves and keys add up. Brass is worth far more than steel, so keep it out of the general scrap and bring it to us.

seo.title: Scrap Brass
seo.description: Sell scrap brass taps, fittings, valves and keys to Metal Werx in Hallam. We grade it, weigh it and pay by bank transfer the same day.

paragraphs.text: Brass is mostly copper mixed with zinc, which is why it's worth so much more than steel. A bucket of old taps and fittings from a renovation or a plumber's van is well worth bringing in.
Like copper, it's graded on how clean it is. Brass with steel, plastic or rubber attached is paid at a lower rate, so a few minutes with a screwdriver or a hacksaw can pay off.

grades.title: Yellow Brass
grades.text: Taps, plumbing fittings, keys, door hardware and other common brass, free of steel and plastic.

grades.title: Red Brass
grades.text: Heavier, redder castings such as valves, water meter bodies and pump housings. Often called gunmetal.

grades.title: Brass Swarf
grades.text: Turnings and shavings from machining, kept dry and free of steel and oil.

grades.title: Brass with Attachments
grades.text: Brass with steel screws, plastic handles or rubber washers still on. Paid at a lower rate.

details.heading: What We Buy
details.intro: Brass turns up all over the house, the workshop and the job site. A magnet helps: brass isn't magnetic, so if a magnet sticks, there's steel inside or it isn't brass.

items.text: Pull off plastic and rubber washers
Keep swarf dry and free of oil

faq.intro: Common questions about selling scrap brass.

questions.question: How can I tell if something is brass?
questions.answer: Brass is yellow to reddish gold, heavy for its size, and a magnet won't stick to it. If a magnet sticks, it's steel plated to look like brass, or there's steel inside.

questions.question: Do chrome-plated taps count as brass?
questions.answer: Many are brass underneath, but some cheaper taps are made of zinc alloy. We'll check yours when you bring them in. Take off the plastic handles and steel screws first.

questions.question: Is brass worth more than copper?
questions.answer: No. Brass is about two-thirds copper, so it pays less than clean copper but much more than steel. Keep the two apart, as a mixed load is paid at the lower price.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

cta.heading: Got Brass to Sell?
cta.text: Bring it to our Hallam yard, or tell us what you've got and we'll give you a price.

title: Alloy Extrusion
heading: Scrap Aluminium Extrusion
summary: Window frames, door frames and sections.
lede: Old window and door frames, flyscreen frames, shopfront sections and extrusion offcuts. Clean alloy extrusion is the best-paying grade of aluminium, so it's worth keeping apart from the rest.

seo.title: Scrap Aluminium Extrusion
seo.description: Sell scrap aluminium extrusion to Metal Werx in Hallam: window and door frames, flyscreen frames, shopfront sections and offcuts. Weighed and paid by the tonne, by bank transfer the same day.

paragraphs.text: Extrusion is aluminium pushed through a die into a long section that's the same shape all the way along. Window and door frames, flyscreen and shower screen frames, shopfronts and handrails are all made from it. Scrap yards call it alloy extrusion, and it's one of the cleanest grades of aluminium.

It has its own price, well above mixed aluminium, as long as it's clean. Glass, rubber seals, plastic inserts, timber and steel screws all count against it, so strip them off before you come in. Extrusion that still has them on is paid at a lower grade.

grades.title: Clean Extrusion
grades.text: Window, door and flyscreen frames and other sections with the glass, rubber, plastic and steel screws removed. The best price.

grades.title: Painted Extrusion
grades.text: Powder-coated, painted and anodised frames and sections, stripped the same way as bare ones.

grades.title: Offcuts & Sections
grades.text: Offcuts from fabricators and window installers, and lengths of aluminium tube, angle and channel.

grades.title: Thermally Broken Frames
grades.text: Double-glazed frames with a plastic strip joining the inner and outer sections. Paid at a lower grade unless the plastic is cut out.

details.heading: Before You Bring It In
details.intro: Not sure it's aluminium? It's light and a magnet won't stick to it. Steel screws, hinges and brackets will, which makes them easy to find and take off.

items.text: Sliding door tracks and shopfront sections

faq.intro: Common questions about selling scrap aluminium extrusion.

questions.question: Do I need to take the glass out of window frames?
questions.answer: If you can. Frames with the glass, rubber and screws removed are paid as clean extrusion, the best price, and broken glass is a hazard in the yard.

questions.question: What's the difference between extrusion and alloy mix?
questions.answer: Extrusion is the long, even sections that frames and profiles are made from. Alloy mix is the rest of your aluminium, such as sheet, castings, and pots and pans. Keep the two apart, and the extrusion is paid at its own, higher price.

questions.question: Is painted or powder-coated aluminium still extrusion?
questions.answer: Yes. Coated and anodised frames are still extrusion. Strip off the glass, rubber, plastic and steel, as you would for bare frames.

questions.question: How can I tell aluminium from steel?
questions.answer: Use a magnet: it sticks to steel but not to aluminium. Aluminium is also much lighter, about a third of the weight of steel.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

cta.heading: Got Old Frames?
cta.text: Bring them to our Hallam yard, or tell us what you've got and we'll give you a price.

title: Alloy Mix
heading: Mixed Scrap Aluminium
summary: Sheet, castings, cans and household aluminium.
lede: Sheet, castings, ladders, pots and pans, boat parts and cans. Alloy mix is the aluminium that isn't extrusion or wheels, and it's worth far more than steel, so keep it out of the steel pile.

seo.title: Mixed Scrap Aluminium
seo.description: Sell mixed scrap aluminium to Metal Werx in Hallam: sheet, castings, ladders, pots and pans, boat parts and cans. Weighed and paid by the tonne, by bank transfer the same day.

paragraphs.text: Alloy mix is the aluminium that isn't clean extrusion or wheels: sheet and plate, castings, ladders, old pots and pans, boat and caravan parts, and cans. It's all paid at one price, so there's no need to sort it into grades.

It does need to be aluminium. Keep steel, plastic, rubber and timber out of it, and take off steel bolts and brackets where you can. Window and door frames are worth more as extrusion, so keep them separate.

grades.title: Sheet & Plate
grades.text: Sheet, plate, roofing, cladding and signs.

grades.title: Cast Aluminium
grades.text: Gearbox housings, lawn mower decks, pump bodies and other castings.

grades.title: Household Aluminium
grades.text: Ladders, pots and pans, outdoor furniture, and boat and caravan parts.

grades.title: Cans
grades.text: Drink cans, crushed or loose. Cans that are eligible for a CDS Vic refund are worth more there.

details.heading: What We Buy
details.intro: Not sure it's aluminium? It's light, silver-grey and a magnet won't stick to it. Stainless steel looks similar but is much heavier.

items.text: Unscrew steel brackets, bolts and screws
Pull off plastic, rubber and timber
Drain oil from gearboxes and pumps
Keep window frames apart, to sell as extrusion

faq.intro: Common questions about selling mixed scrap aluminium.

questions.question: What's the difference between alloy mix and extrusion?
questions.answer: Extrusion is clean window frames, door frames and other long sections, and it's paid at a higher price. Alloy mix is the rest of your aluminium. Keep the two apart and you'll be paid more for the extrusion.

questions.question: Should I bring my drink cans here?
questions.answer: Eligible drink cans earn a 10c refund each through CDS Vic, Victoria's container deposit scheme, which is far more than they're worth as scrap. We'll take cans that aren't eligible, along with your other aluminium.

questions.question: Does a bit of steel matter?
questions.answer: A few screws won't hurt, but bolts, brackets and steel inserts left on lower the price of the load. A magnet will find them: it sticks to steel, not aluminium.

questions.question: How can I tell aluminium from stainless steel?
questions.answer: Weight is the giveaway: aluminium is about a third as heavy as steel. A magnet usually won't stick to either, but stainless steel is much heavier for its size.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

cta.heading: Got Aluminium to Sell?

title: Aluminium Wheels
heading: Scrap Alloy Wheels
summary: Alloy rims from cars, utes and trucks.
lede: Upgraded your rims, or got a stack of old alloys in the garage? Aluminium wheels are one of the cleanest grades of aluminium, and we'll pay you for every one.

seo.title: Scrap Aluminium Wheels
seo.description: Sell old alloy wheels and rims to Metal Werx in Hallam. Car, ute and truck aluminium wheels, weighed and paid by bank transfer the same day.

paragraphs.text: Alloy wheels are cast from a high grade of aluminium, so they're worth more than most aluminium scrap, as long as they're clean. Tyres, wheel weights, valve stems and centre caps all count against the price.
We buy them one at a time or by the pallet, from car and ute wheels to heavy truck rims. Tyre shops, wreckers and mechanics can ask us about regular pickups.

grades.title: Clean Alloy Wheels
grades.text: Car and ute wheels with the tyre, weights, valve stem and centre cap removed. The best price.

grades.title: Dirty Alloy Wheels
grades.text: Wheels with weights, valve stems or other attachments still on. Paid at a lower rate.

grades.title: Truck Wheels
grades.text: Heavy aluminium rims from trucks, buses and trailers.

grades.title: Chrome-Plated Wheels
grades.text: Chrome-plated alloys are graded on their own, at a lower rate than painted wheels.

details.heading: Before You Bring Them In
details.intro: A clean wheel gets the best price, so strip off anything that isn't aluminium. Steel wheels are welcome too, though they're paid as steel.

items.text: Truck, bus and trailer alloy rims
Valve stems and tyre pressure sensors

faq.intro: Common questions about selling alloy wheels.

questions.question: Do the tyres need to come off?
questions.answer: For the best price, yes. If you have wheels with the tyres still on, get in touch first and we'll let you know what we can do.

questions.question: Do you buy damaged or bent wheels?
questions.answer: Yes. Cracked, bent or kerbed wheels are worth the same as good ones, as we pay for the aluminium, not the wheel.

questions.question: What about the wheel weights?
questions.answer: Wheel weights can be lead, steel or zinc. Prise them off before you come in, and we'll buy the lead ones as lead.

questions.question: Do you buy steel wheels?
questions.answer: Yes, but they're paid as steel, which is worth much less than aluminium. A magnet will tell you which you've got: it sticks to steel, not aluminium.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

cta.heading: Got Old Wheels?

title: Stainless Steel
heading: Scrap Stainless Steel
lede: Old sinks, kitchen benches, tanks and fabrication offcuts. Stainless steel pays far more than ordinary steel, so it's worth keeping separate.

seo.title: Scrap Stainless Steel
seo.description: Sell scrap stainless steel to Metal Werx in Hallam: sinks, benches, tanks, pipe and offcuts. Graded, weighed and paid by bank transfer the same day.

paragraphs.text: Most stainless steel in kitchens, bathrooms and food and dairy equipment is grade 304 or 316. Both contain nickel and chromium, which is why they're worth so much more than ordinary steel.
Cheaper magnetic stainless, found in some appliances, cutlery and exhausts, is graded on its own at a lower price. We sort it with a magnet, so you're paid for what you actually have.

grades.title: 304 Stainless
grades.text: Sinks, benches, splashbacks, kitchen equipment and most offcuts. Non-magnetic.

grades.title: 316 Stainless
grades.text: Marine fittings, and dairy, chemical and food-processing equipment. Pays more than 304.

grades.title: Magnetic Stainless
grades.text: 400-series stainless from some appliances, cutlery and exhausts. Paid at a lower rate.

grades.title: Stainless with Attachments
grades.text: Tanks and equipment with steel frames, motors or plastic still on. Paid at a lower rate until stripped.

details.heading: What We Buy
details.intro: If it's stainless, we'll take it, from a single sink to a commercial kitchen fit-out. The magnet test is a good guide: a magnet barely sticks, if at all, to the better grades.

items.text: Remove steel frames, legs and brackets
Take off motors, plastic and rubber

faq.intro: Common questions about selling scrap stainless steel.

questions.question: How can I tell if it's stainless steel?
questions.answer: It's shiny, doesn't rust easily and is heavy for its size. On the common 304 and 316 grades, a magnet barely sticks, if at all. If a magnet grabs it hard, it's magnetic stainless or plated steel.

questions.question: Do you buy whole commercial kitchens?
questions.answer: Yes. Benches, sinks, shelving and equipment from a restaurant or café fit-out are all welcome. For a big job, we can collect.

questions.question: Is stainless steel worth more than steel?
questions.answer: Much more, thanks to the nickel and chromium in it. Keep it out of your steel pile so it's paid at the stainless price.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

title: HMS Steel
heading: HMS Scrap Steel
summary: Beams, plate, channel, pipe and heavy offcuts.
lede: Beams, plate, channel, thick pipe and structural offcuts. HMS, short for heavy melting steel, is the thick, clean steel that steelworks melt down, and it's paid by the tonne. Bring a trailer load to our Hallam yard, or we'll collect a big one.

seo.title: HMS Scrap Steel
seo.description: Sell HMS (heavy melting steel) scrap to Metal Werx in Hallam: beams, plate, channel, pipe and structural offcuts. Weighed and paid by the tonne, by bank transfer the same day.

paragraphs.text: HMS stands for heavy melting steel: steel thick and clean enough for a steelworks to melt down as it is. It's the main grade of scrap steel, and most of it comes from demolition, building sites, fabrication shops and farms.

It's paid by the tonne, at a price that follows the steel market. We check every load at the yard, and steel that's thin, or still has timber, concrete, plastic or rubber on it, doesn't make the HMS grade. Copper, brass, aluminium and stainless steel are worth far more, so take them off and bring them in separately.

grades.title: HMS 1
grades.text: Clean steel about 6 mm thick or more: beams, columns, plate and heavy structural offcuts.

grades.title: HMS 2
grades.text: Steel about 3 to 6 mm thick, painted and galvanised steel included: channel, angle, flat bar and lighter sections.

grades.title: Pipe & Hollow Section
grades.text: Thick-walled steel pipe, tube and box section, empty of water, oil and anything else.

grades.title: Steel with Attachments
grades.text: Frames, trailers and tanks with timber, concrete, plastic or rubber still on. Paid at a lower rate until stripped.

details.heading: What We Buy
details.intro: From a few lengths of beam to a demolition job. Bring smaller loads to our Hallam yard in the ute or on a trailer. For bigger ones, hire a bin or book a pickup.

items.text: Drums or tanks with fuel, oil or chemicals in them
Asbestos, and anything contaminated with it
Timber, concrete, plastic and general rubbish

faq.intro: Common questions about selling HMS scrap steel.

questions.question: What is HMS steel?
questions.answer: HMS stands for heavy melting steel. It's thick steel, such as beams, plate, channel and heavy pipe, that a steelworks can melt down without much processing. It's graded as HMS 1 or HMS 2 by how thick and clean it is.

questions.question: How much do you pay for HMS steel?
questions.answer: HMS is paid by the tonne, at a price that follows the steel market. Our current guide is on our Scrap Prices page, and we confirm the price when your load is weighed. Clean steel with nothing attached gets the full HMS price.

questions.question: Is roofing iron HMS?
questions.answer: No. Roofing iron, sheet, guttering and other steel thinner than about 3 mm is too light to be HMS. Tell us what you've got and we'll give you a price for it.

questions.question: Is a trailer load worth bringing in?
questions.answer: Yes. We weigh every load, from a car boot to a truck, and pay you for what it weighs. If you've got more than a trailer can carry, hire a bin or ask us to collect.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

title: Electric Motors
heading: Scrap Electric Motors
lede: Burnt-out pump motors, old alternators and starter motors, compressor and machinery motors. They're full of copper windings, so they're worth more than plain steel.

seo.title: Scrap Electric Motors
seo.description: Sell scrap electric motors, alternators and starter motors to Metal Werx in Hallam. Weighed and paid by bank transfer the same day, with no stripping needed.

paragraphs.text: An electric motor is a steel or aluminium case wrapped around copper windings. That copper is why motors have their own price, well above steel, and why you shouldn't throw them in with the rest of your scrap.
There's no need to pull them apart. Drain any oil, bring them in whole, and we'll weigh them and pay for them as motors.

grades.title: Electric Motors
grades.text: Motors from pumps, compressors, machinery, fans and appliances.

grades.title: Alternators
grades.text: Car, truck and machinery alternators, whole.

grades.title: Starter Motors
grades.text: Starters from cars, trucks, tractors and boats.

grades.title: Sealed Units
grades.text: Fridge and air-con compressors, once the gas has been removed by a licensed technician.

details.heading: What We Buy
details.intro: Big or small, working or burnt out, we'll take it. We pay for the metal, so it makes no difference whether a motor still runs.

items.text: Drain oil from gearboxes and pumps
Take the batteries out of power tools
Have compressors degassed by a licensed technician
Cut off long power leads and sell them as wire

faq.intro: Common questions about selling electric motors.

questions.question: Do I need to strip the copper out?
questions.answer: No. Motors are bought whole, at their own price. Pulling the copper out takes hours and is rarely worth it for small motors.

questions.question: Do you buy motors that don't work?
questions.answer: Yes. We pay for the metal, so it makes no difference whether a motor runs.

questions.question: Can I bring in a whole fridge or air conditioner?
questions.answer: Only once a licensed technician has removed the refrigerant gas. It's illegal to release it, so we can't take fridges or air-con units that still hold gas.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

title: Black Compressors
heading: Scrap Compressors
summary: Sealed compressors from fridges and air-cons.
lede: The sealed black compressors from fridges, freezers, air conditioners and coolrooms. Inside the steel shell is a motor wound with copper, so they're worth more than plain steel.

seo.title: Scrap Compressors
seo.description: Sell scrap fridge, freezer and air-con compressors to Metal Werx in Hallam. Sealed black compressors, degassed, weighed and paid by the tonne, by bank transfer the same day.

paragraphs.text: A black compressor is the sealed, dome-shaped pump at the heart of a fridge, freezer or air conditioner. Its welded steel shell holds an electric motor with copper windings, which is why compressors have their own price, above steel.

Bring them in whole: there's no need to cut them open. The refrigerant gas has to be recovered by a licensed technician before a compressor comes out of its unit, and we can't take any that still hold gas.

grades.title: Fridge & Freezer
grades.text: Compressors from household fridges, freezers and bar fridges.

grades.title: Air Conditioner
grades.text: Compressors from split system, window and ducted air conditioners.

grades.title: Commercial Refrigeration
grades.text: Compressors from coolrooms, display fridges, ice machines and drink chillers.

grades.title: Heat Pump
grades.text: Compressors from heat pump hot water systems and pool heaters.

details.heading: What We Buy
details.intro: One at a time or by the pallet, from a home, a workshop or a refrigeration job. The gas has to be recovered by a licensed technician first.

items.text: Have the gas recovered by a licensed technician
Leave the shell sealed: don't cut it open
Cut off brackets, rubber feet and long pipes
Keep compressors apart from electric motors

faq.intro: Common questions about selling scrap compressors.

questions.question: What is a black compressor?
questions.answer: It's the sealed compressor from a fridge, freezer or air conditioner, usually painted black. The steel shell is welded shut around a motor and pump, so it's bought whole, at its own price.

questions.question: Does the gas need to be removed?
questions.answer: Yes. A licensed technician has to recover the refrigerant before the compressor comes out. It's illegal to release it, so we can't take compressors that still hold gas.

questions.question: Should I cut it open for the copper?
questions.answer: No. Compressors are bought whole. Cutting one open spills the oil inside and takes a long time for very little gain.

questions.question: Are compressors the same as electric motors?
questions.answer: Not quite. Both have copper windings, but a compressor's motor is sealed inside a steel shell with the pump, so it has its own price. Keep them apart and each is paid at its own rate.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

cta.heading: Got Compressors to Sell?
cta.text: Bring them to our Hallam yard, or tell us how many you've got and we'll give you a price.

title: AC Units
heading: Scrap Air Conditioners
summary: Split system, window and ducted units.
lede: Old split systems, window and wall units, portable and ducted air conditioners. They're full of copper pipe and aluminium fins, so whole units have their own price, once the gas is out.

seo.title: Scrap Air Conditioners
seo.description: Sell old air conditioners to Metal Werx in Hallam: split system, window, portable and ducted AC units, once degassed. Weighed and paid by the tonne, by bank transfer the same day.

paragraphs.text: An air conditioner is a steel case around a compressor, copper pipe, aluminium fins and a fan motor. Whole units are bought at their own price, so there's no need to pull them apart.

Before we can take one, the refrigerant gas has to be removed by a licensed technician. It's illegal to release it, so units that still hold gas can't come into the yard. If you're replacing a system, ask your installer to recover the gas from the old one.

grades.title: Window & Wall Units

grades.title: Portable Units
grades.text: Portable and free-standing air conditioners.

grades.title: Ducted & Commercial
grades.text: Ducted system outdoor units, and rooftop and commercial units. Ask us to collect the big ones.

questions.question: Can I bring in an air conditioner that still has gas in it?
questions.answer: No. The refrigerant has to be recovered by a licensed technician first, as it's illegal to release it. Your installer can usually do this when they take the old unit out.

questions.question: Do you buy air conditioners that don't work?
questions.answer: Yes. We pay for the metal, so it makes no difference whether a unit still runs.

questions.question: Should I take the compressor out?
questions.answer: There's no need. Units are bought whole, compressor and all. If you already have loose compressors, we buy those too, as black compressors.

questions.question: Can you collect commercial units?
questions.answer: Yes. For rooftop or ducted units, or a whole building's worth, tell us what you have and where it is, and we'll arrange a pickup.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

title: White Engines
heading: Scrap Aluminium Engines
summary: Aluminium engines from cars, bikes and boats.
lede: Aluminium engines from cars, utes, motorbikes, outboards and mowers. Scrap yards call them white engines, and we buy them whole, so there's no need to strip them.

seo.title: Scrap Aluminium Engines
seo.description: Sell scrap aluminium engines, or white engines, to Metal Werx in Hallam: car, motorbike, outboard and small engines, bought whole. Weighed and paid by the tonne, by bank transfer the same day.

paragraphs.text: A white engine is an engine with an aluminium block, as many car engines and most motorbike, outboard and small engines are. The name sets it apart from a cast iron engine, which is dark grey and much heavier.

We buy them whole, at their own price, which allows for the steel crankshaft, valves and bolts inside. Drain the oil, fuel and coolant, take off anything that isn't part of the engine, and bring it in.

details.heading: Getting Them Ready
details.intro: Not sure it's aluminium? A magnet won't stick to a flat part of the block, away from the bolts, and it's lighter than a cast iron engine of the same size.

faq.intro: Common questions about selling scrap aluminium engines.

questions.question: What is a white engine?
questions.answer: An engine with an aluminium block, rather than a cast iron one. Scrap yards call them white because aluminium is pale silver, while cast iron is dark grey.

questions.question: How do I know if my engine is aluminium?
questions.answer: Try a magnet on a flat part of the block, away from the bolts. It won't stick to aluminium, but it will to cast iron. Aluminium engines are also much lighter for their size.

questions.question: Do I need to drain the oil?
questions.answer: Yes. Drain the oil, fuel and coolant before you come in. They're hazardous waste, and engines that still hold them can't go in with the scrap.

questions.question: Do you buy engines that don't run?
questions.answer: Yes. Seized, cracked or blown, we pay for the metal, so it makes no difference whether an engine runs.

questions.question: How do I get paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day your metal is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, and we need to see your photo ID.

cta.heading: Got Old Engines?
cta.text: Bring them to our Hallam yard, or tell us what you've got and we'll give you a price.
